hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q 'git commit' && printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'co-authored-by|noreply@anthropic|generated with.*claude'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"keel rule: commits must not carry a Claude/Anthropic Co-Authored-By trailer or attribution."}}'; fi
